''See also: [[Imperial Guard Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Imperial]] Guard is a massive and highly visible [[Imperial]] [[Guild]] characterized by its red-and-black uniforms, which feature the [[Aurelian]] Shield crest. As one of the most numerous guilds, they serve as a primary security force for [[The Empire|the Empire]], responsible for patrolling storehouses, settling riots, and securing the borders of the [[Imperial]] Palace. They are known for their extreme alertness, paranoia, and absolute loyalty to the Emperor; it is believed that without an Emperor, the guild would eventually collapse. While some elite guilds view them as having lower entry requirements suited for mundane tasks, the Guard is widely recognized for its ability to detect intruders and maintain order in the Capital. A defining feature of the guild is the use of alchemical and [[Reading]] processes to imbue members with [[Kameira enhancements]]. These secret modifications replace body parts with inhuman appendages—such as reptilian arms, eagle eyes, tentacles, or crocodile teeth—which grant the guards enhanced abilities and bind them to the guild. Despite these monstrous physical traits, the guild is led by [[Jarelys Teach]], a powerful General who maintains a human appearance while possessing immense strength and endurance. The guild's stability is closely tied to the presence of a true Emperor, as they are considered a relic of the imperial system that lacks a purpose in its absence.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Led by [[Jarelys Teach]], the [[Imperial]] Guard is a group of individuals wearing pressed red-and-black uniforms adorned with a golden shield crest bearing the [[Imperial Seal]]. Funded by the resources of the [[Imperial]] Palace, these soldiers—who are characterized by their mismatched body parts—have helped restore order to the Capital. While they can be requisitioned by any prison in the city during emergencies, the organization is said to fall apart without an Emperor and carries a history filled with stories of rebels and traitors. During the events involving [[The Testament]], the group called for the Captain and launched an invasion.}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Imperial]] Guard is a high-status combatant group composed of uniformed men and women who serve as guards for the Emperor and secure the palace borders. Members of this unit often have their body parts replaced with [[Kameira]] equivalents, and some individuals even possess [[Imperial]] Guard blood. During chaotic moments, guards such as an orange-eyed member have been seen shouting orders while fleeing. The group's influence is seen in various ways, from [[Jarelys Teach]]'s membership to the way [[Lucan]] performs a salute. Even their leadership is notable, as the Heads of the [[Imperial]] Guard have signed letters of personal regret.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As a military force within the Capital, the [[Imperial]] Guard is composed of diverse members possessing enhanced senses, including individuals with fox ears, tusks, or scaled arms. These soldiers wear impressive red-and-black uniforms enhanced by [[Kameira]] and are significantly larger than [[Calder]], whom they accompany. While stationed to guard the [[Rose Tower]] and the [[Emperor's personal rooms|Emperor’s chambers]], the unit also includes specialized doctors trained in unusual biology. The [[Imperial]] Guard gathers outside the main door of the [[Rose Tower]] and serves as the primary troop force defending [[The Testament]], even becoming a subject of betting for [[Calder]].}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Imperial]] Guard provides open security for the Imperialist faction, with their numerous members spread throughout various locations. While they secure the tunnels of the [[Imperial]] Palace, their patrols can occasionally be overwhelmed by packs of scavengers. A team consisting of [[Magisters]] and members of the Guard once awaited [[Shera]] upon the wall, and several of [[Trip]]'s friends from the unit eventually spotted him. Although thousands of people wear the [[Imperial]] Guard uniform, the group is also the lineage from which [[Ayana]] inherited [[Kameira blood]].}}
